import sys,json,tempfile,pathlib,subprocess,hashlib,difflib,gzip,base64,shutil
p=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);r=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="hamon-tt-readme-",dir="/dev"))
try:
 def blob(s):
  b=s.encode();return hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()
 for k in ["base","ours","theirs"]:
  assert blob(p[k])==p[k+"Sha"]
  (r/k).write_text(p[k],encoding="utf-8",newline="")
 cmd=["git","merge-file","--diff3","--stdout",str(r/"ours"),str(r/"base"),str(r/"theirs")]
 run=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True)
 assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr+"\n"+run.stdout
 merged=run.stdout
 assert merged==p["expected"]
 assert merged.count(p["addition"])==1
 assert merged.replace(p["addition"],"",1)==p["theirs"]
 before=p["base"].splitlines(keepends=True);after=p["theirs"].splitlines(keepends=True)
 changes=[]
 for tag,a,b,c,d in difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=before,b=after,autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
  if tag=="equal":continue
  assert tag=="insert",tag
  addition="".join(after[c:d]);assert merged.count(addition)==1
  changes.append({"originalLine":a+1,"addition":addition})
 inverse=merged
 for x in changes:inverse=inverse.replace(x["addition"],"",1)
 assert inverse==p["ours"]
 summary={"status":"pass","mergeExit":run.returncode,"mergedBlob":blob(merged),"mergedBytes":len(merged.encode()),"originalBlob":p["baseSha"],"qualifiedV2ReadmeBlob":p["oursSha"],"currentMainReadmeBlob":p["theirsSha"],"inverseOursRestoresCurrentMainExactly":True,"inverseIncomingRestoresQualifiedReadmeExactly":True,"incomingReadmeAdditions":changes,"runtimeCodeChanged":False}
 files={k+".md":p[k] for k in ["base","ours","theirs"]}
 files["merged.md"]=merged;files["command.json"]=json.dumps({"command":cmd,"exit":run.returncode,"stdout":run.stdout,"stderr":run.stderr},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n"
 files["summary.json"]=json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n"
 packed=gzip.compress(json.dumps({"files":files},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":")).encode(),mtime=0)
 print(json.dumps({"summary":summary,"merged":merged,"packet":{"encoding":"base64+gzip+json","bytes":len(packed),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest(),"content":base64.b64encode(packed).decode()}},ensure_ascii=False))
finally:shutil.rmtree(r,ignore_errors=True)
